felix mobile plan FAQs

How do I sign up to felix?

Signing up and switching over to felix is easy! Simply download the app or continue on our website to sign up and choose your preferred plan. You can choose to switch with an eSIM or physical SIM. Then, all that’s left to do is activate it within the app. See help for common sign up FAQs or reach out to our team on live chat via the felix app or website.

Can I bring my number when switching to felix?

Yes! You can bring your own number or get a new one - it's up to you. Simply choose your preferred option on sign up.

What is a SIM only mobile plan?

A SIM only mobile plan is a mobile plan that provides you with a SIM card only (no mobile device), alongside a range of services including talk, text and data inclusions. With a SIM only phone plan, you’re purchasing a mobile service without the cost of a phone included.

Does felix offer eSIM?

Yes, we do! New and existing customers can choose an eSIM on any of our plans, at no extra cost. If you’re new to felix and have a compatible device, simply select eSIM when signing up to felix. See our eSIM page for more information. 

If you’re already a felix customer, simply head to the felix app and under the Settings tap, select Replace or swap your SIM.  

Don’t have an eSIM compatible phone? No stress! You can still sign up to felix with a physical SIM, which will be express posted to you on sign up.

How much is unlimited data?

Our unlimited data plan at speeds up to 40Mbps is $40 per month on a no lock-in contract.

What is the felix 7 day Happiness Guarantee?

This is available to new customers. We hope you'll think we're peachy, but if you don't, you can get your money back on all three of our plans if you contact us within seven days of activating your SIM via live chat in the app. See below for full terms and conditions. 

Can I contact emergency services using a BYO device?

Yes, you can contact emergency services using an approved felix device.

Using a device other than an approved felix device may impact your ability to call emergency services.

Can I cancel at anytime?

You can cancel your felix plan at any time with no exit fees. Or, if you need a break, you can also pause your plan for up to 119  days, after which time your account will be suspended. Find out more about pausing here. 

What is the Fair Use Policy?

You can find our Fair Use Policy here.

felix wallet – Refer a friend felix customers can share a unique code with friends. When your friend inserts your unique code, signs up to any felix subscription (Eligible Subscription) and activates their felix SIM, they'll receive 50% off their first 4 months and you'll receive $10 of felix wallet credit (Discount). Discount will be applied towards your next felix purchase, such as your next Eligible Subscription renewal. You may share your unique code as many times as you like, but your referring friend must enter this code when signing up to an Eligible Subscription, it cannot be applied retrospectively. You can start referring after activation of your felix SIM. Discount expires when your Eligible Subscription is cancelled. Discount cannot be transferred. Subject to change.

felix 7 Day Happiness Guarantee The 7 Day Happiness Guarantee is available to you if you’re a new felix customer.  To make a claim, you can contact us within 7 days of activating your SIM via Live Chat either on the Felix Mobile App or through the website - http://felixmobile.com.au .

We will refund to you 100% of the first Monthly Subscription Charges including Charges for the Unlimited International Calls and Text product if selected by you, Charges for the International Roaming product if any, taxes if any, and your shipping costs. If a felix promotion has been applied to your Charges or shipping costs, only the actual amount paid by you will be refunded. We will discuss a process to refund all costs that works for you when you contact us. If you purchased your felix SIM Pack in-store, you must provide proof of purchase in form of a clear and legible receipt.

Unless you are transferring your number to another provider, your Subscription will be considered finalised on the date we terminate your Subscription.  If you are transferring your number to another provider you must do so within 5 business days of making the claim, in which case your phone plan will be finalised once your number has been successfully transferred. If you do not transfer your number within 5 business days after making your claim, we will terminate your Subscription.

If you’re buying a new Subscription, the 7 Day Happiness Guarantee only applies to the new Subscription and not to any existing Subscriptions you have – unless, of course, they are less than 7 days young themselves and also eligible.

If there are any Discounts on your Account that have been given to you by felix, they won't be refunded, exchanged or redeemable for cash when you claim.

None of this will affect any other rights or remedies you may have under the Competition and Consumer Act 2010 (Cth). TPG Telecom Limited ABN 76 096 304 620.
